title: Playground Chrome Reliability
description: Fix broken window chrome in wgpu playgrounds (navbar, window borders, tabs/chips, sizing). Harden AppBuilder registration so malformed layouts are impossible. Replace free-form panel group strings with PanelGroup enum.
summary: Fixed procedural3d missing navbar/footer/window chrome by introducing with_chrome_sink() in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs. Chrome draws (navbar, footer, dock paint_chrome caps/borders, measures/engagement rails) now route to the overlay DrawList composited last, preventing full-pane node-graph raster quads from painting over shell chrome. Prior AppBuilder/PanelGroup hardening unchanged.
